title: 後部投入式ごみ収集車
description: 住宅街や清掃拠点のシーンに配置する三軸の後部投入式ごみ収集車です。短い乗員キャブ、三本の車軸と後部の複輪、上肩を面取りした大きな圧縮室外装、側面補強材と点検蓋、実際に開口した後部ホッパー、斜面のある受け皿と奥の固定ブレード、外側の支持アーム・ピン・シリンダー外装と曲線ホース、後部ステップと手すりを備えます。キャブは淡いアルファ透過窓から造形済みの二席・操舵輪・計器を見通せます。圧縮室内部、廃棄物、機関内部は省略し、灯火とミラーは不透明・非作動です。屈折ガラス、走行・操舵・圧縮・油圧・扉開閉動作や実機性能・安全性の検証は含みません。全体で一モデルです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）3.030 × 3.260 × 8.470 m、178,372三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A three-axle rear-loading refuse truck for residential streets and municipal depots. Its compact crew cab, three axles with rear twin tires, large chamfered-shoulder compactor exterior, side ribs and service hatches are distinct from the other vehicles. The rear hopper is genuinely open, with a sloping bowl, recessed fixed blade, exterior support arms, pins, cylinder exteriors and curved service hoses, plus rear steps and handholds. Lightly tinted alpha-blended cab windows reveal two modeled seats, steering wheel and blank instruments. Internal compactor chamber, refuse and engine internals are omitted; lamps and mirrors are opaque and inactive. No refractive-glass simulation, driving, steering, compaction, hydraulic or door behavior, real-machine performance or safety validation is included. All components form one complete model. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 3.030 × 3.260 × 8.470 m; 178,372 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
